summary: Tested in-app content translation (Emergent LLM, shared engine) for chat + legal docs. Backend: 11/11 pytest pass (/translate/batch auth/empty/cache/same-lang passthrough/invalid-target fail-open, /translate single, /legal?lang list+doc, original without lang, 404, admin POST/PUT legal pre-warm -> subsequent GET ?lang=en <2s, cleanup). Frontend (mobile 390x844): match_a chat switched to English via tray-lang -> chat-translating pill shown, all Russian bubbles translated together (~2.6s), no Cyrillic left; toggle-orig works both ways; reply quotes + reply-preview translated; location place translated (incl. newly sent location); realtime incoming Russian message from match_b auto-translated in <1s without reload; switching back to Russian re-renders all (English -> Russian); deleted placeholder (scope=everyone) shows live in English; UI send/reply/location send OK. Legal: en list/doc correct (built-ins are authored in English so en shows original w/o toggle); de list+doc translated with legal-toggle-orig toggling; refund-policy still shows refund-form.

minor.issue: Public, unauthenticated and lang is unvalidated (any 1-10 char string) -> anyone can trigger LLM translation of all legal docs for arbitrary language codes (cost abuse; each new code ~10-20s of LLM work and a cache row). Consider whitelisting supported language codes.

Iterates every distinct users.language_pref including the doc's own source language (e.g. 'en' for English built-ins) -> wasted LLM calls; asyncio.create_task result not referenced (may be GC'd mid-run).

texts max_length=300 -> 422 for threads with >300 distinct texts; frontend hook sends all missing texts in one request without chunking, so very long chats would fail-open to originals (mixed screen). Chunk on frontend or raise/slice server-side.

ui_bugs.issue: Intermittent (seen once, not reproducible on reload): after switching language en->de in same browser context, raw i18n keys rendered ('legal.translated · chat.show_original', bottom nav 'nav.home', 'nav.search'...). Backend /api/i18n/de returned full dict, so likely a race between concurrent load() calls (initial lang effect + user language_pref sync) with no request sequencing/abort.

issues: LLM translates English-ish test markers too: 'TEST_hi' rendered as 'ТЕСТ_привет' - identifiers/code-like tokens get translated (expected behaviour per spec but may surprise).

action_items: Optional: whitelist lang codes on public /api/legal?lang endpoints to prevent LLM cost abuse
Optional: chunk /translate/batch calls in useChatTranslation (<=300 texts per request) for long threads
Optional: add request sequencing (ignore stale responses) in I18nProvider.load to avoid rare raw-key render
critical_code_review_comments: translation.py: per-item update_one in a loop after each chunk - use bulk_write for fewer round trips
_prewarm_legal skips nothing: translates into the source language too
useChatTranslation: no chunking; frontend relies on server 300 cap

success_rate.frontend: 100% (1 intermittent low-priority i18n race observed once)
